gen-gf-gabarito-gf-assistant: Gabarito draws every curve with one unpinched nib, terminals cut open. It earns its place in big, short lines, while Assistant keeps the sans-serif text quietly out of its way.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-asta-sans: Gabarito looks drawn with a single nib, its terminals cut open. Asta Sans goes tubelike and constant-weight underneath, so the expressive heading and approachable text sit together without fuss.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-barlow: Barlow feels approachable and contemporary, with neon-tube strokes of constant width and curves whose tips pull well apart. The standout is Gabarito, a display heading cut with one expressive nib.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Bpmf Zihi Kai Std reads approachable, its counters staying connected to the outside and its curves swelling only slightly. Gabarito punches with monoline display strokes; the body font handles quiet text.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-cambay: Gabarito's spaghetti-like strokes keep the same width all the way through. Cambay's rounds gap like a cracked bangle, a modern text face that leaves the heading room to be loud.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-cantarell: Hand-drawn and expressive: Gabarito's nib-drawn curves spill open at the terminals, while Cantarell holds its c tips well apart. Beside that, Cantarell's sans feels approachable, neutral and quietly grounded.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-electrolize: Electrolize brings an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers, modern and contemporary against Gabarito's technical-pen steadiness. Paragraphs in it would feel crisp, modern and distinctly mechanical, never soft.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-encode-sans-expanded: Encode Sans Expanded keeps its c tips pulled well apart, an approachable sans-serif beneath Gabarito's tubing-gauge strokes. Placed against each other, one feels freshly drawn and the other quietly measured.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-encode-sans-sc: Rods, not blades: Gabarito builds its letters from constant-width lines, their terminals cut open and flowing outward. Encode Sans SC settles into text with shallow terminal curls and a wide gap, professional and steady across many lines.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-encode-sans-semi-cond: The body reads modern and approachable, with an s that opens wide beneath Gabarito's constant-width pen line. Encode Sans Semi Condensed carries paragraphs easily, so pages of it go by without friction.
